outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter plots with individual data points (dots/squares) for each animal overlaid on the mean ± SD bars.
Panel B shows representative gross photographs of mice, not a quantitative plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C shows representative micrograph images (H&E and Oil Red O staining), not a quantitative plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel D shows a dot blot and methylene blue staining image, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue ratio is shown as a bar chart with individual data points (dots) for each of the 5 mice per group overlaid.
Panel F includes a western blot plus a bottom bar chart of TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH ratios; individual data points (dots/squares) for each animal are overlaid on the bars.
